title: Najran Cement publishes 2025 Annual Sustainability Report
summary: Najran Cement publishes 2025 Annual Sustainability Report
body_markdown:
**Saudi Arabia:** Najran Cement has published its 2025 Annual Sustainability Report. Among other metrics, the report records a 17% year-on-year decline in its emissions intensity to 693kg/t CO2 – down by 40% from 2023 levels. The company produced a total of 2.67Mt of cement. Combined Scope 1 and Scope 2 CO2 emissions were 1.85Mt. Najran Cement said that it will also report Scope 3 emissions in future reporting cycles.


[The report is accessible through the Saudi Exchange website](https://www.saudiexchange.sa/wps/portal/saudiexchange/newsandreports/issuer-news/issuer-announcements/issuer-announcements-details/?anId=98466&anCat=1&cs=3002&locale=en) .
